{{Quote|Well, truth to tell, when I left, home was pretty shoddy and run down, but now Delemede is a thriving place. I can't wait to get back, but this time I'll fly transit.|Bosbit Matarcher, HoloNet News report|<ref name="HNN" />}}
'''Delemede''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] astronomical object located in the [[Rseik sector/Legends|Rseik sector]]. [[Governor/Legends|Overseen]] by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Delemede governor|governor]], Delemede was struck by a [[Delemede plague|plague]] around [[3643 BBY]]. At that [[Time/Legends|time]], the governor refused to provide medical aid to [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] on Delemede, but he eventually changed his mind.

In [[212 BBY]], [[Bosbit Matarcher]], a native of Delemede, left the celestial body on a faulty [[Delemedian starhopper|starship]]. Upon the engagement of the [[Starship/Legends|vessel's]] [[Hyperdrive/Legends|jump drive]], Matarcher was [[Time travel/Legends|transported]] [[22 BBY/Legends|190 years]] into the future. When Matarcher was subsequently interviewed by [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]], he claimed his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] had prospered during his [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]]-long trip and that he intended to return there.

==Description==
Delemede was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="On Both Their Houses" /> located in the [[Delemede system/Legends|Delemede system]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Rseik sector/Legends|Rseik sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
===A plague on a Republic world===
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "On Both Their Houses" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the game, the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> Delemede was a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and was [[Administrator/Legends|administrated]] by a [[Delemede governor|governor]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], a [[Delemede plague|plague]] broke out on the celestial body, and the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] denied medical aid to a group of [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="On Both Their Houses" />

Subsequently, a Republic-allied individual dispatched a companion who reminded the governor that if he helped more people, the Republic would in turn grant him more resources. As a result, the governor acquiesced and granted the refugees treatment.<ref name="On Both Their Houses" />
{{Endgame}}

===Time-traveler's home===
{{Quote|I engaged the jump drive for a trip in outsystem. It took about two hours. When I got out, it was 200 years later.|Bosbit Matarcher, HoloNet News report|<ref name="HNN" />}}
[[File:Bosbit_Matarcher.png|thumb|right|220px|Bosbit Matarcher, native of Delemede]]
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bosbit Matarcher]]<ref name="HNN" /> was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on Delemede<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|293|Matarcher, Bosbit}}</ref> in [[247 BBY/Legends|247 BBY]].<ref name="MatarcherDates">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|48|life/13321_2.html|225-year Old Man's Secret? Time Dilation}} establishes that [[Bosbit Matarcher]] was 225 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] 13:3:21 and that he [[Time travel/Legends|traveled]] in [[Time/Legends|time]] at the age 35. Since the date 13:3:21 corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]], Matarcher must have been [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in [[247 BBY/Legends|247 BBY]] and must have time-traveled in [[212 BBY]].</ref> When he was [[212 BBY|35 standard years]] old, Matarcher, who had acquired a [[Delemedian starhopper]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]], engaged the vessel's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|jump drive]] while on a<ref name="HNN" /> regular,<ref name="CSWE" /> two-[[Standard hour/Legends|hour]]-long trip in the Delemede [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Due to the starship's faulty [[relativistic shield]]ing, the starhopper&mdash;and Matarcher himself&mdash;was [[Time travel/Legends|propelled]] 190 years into the future.<ref name="HNN" />

On the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] [[22 BBY/Legends|13:3:21]], Matarcher's story was reported on from [[Wozin]], Delemede in an issue of the [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]]. When interviewed, the accidental [[Time/Legends|time]]-traveler compared the "shoddy" and "run-down" home on Delemede he had left behind to the celestial body that was thriving<ref name="HNN" /> by 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="MatarcherDates" /> Matarcher also expressed his desire to return to Delemede, although, given his experience, he stated he would fly transit.<ref name="HNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Delemede was first featured in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 48|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #48'']], an [[in-universe]] issue of the HoloNet News<ref name="HNN" /> written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]]<ref name="Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref> and published on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]] on [[March 21]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN48 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6128630|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=PrinceXizor|date=2002-03-21|time=3:24 PM}}</ref> Hidalgo crafted Bosbit Matarcher's story in that issue as a reference to the satirical news article "134-Year-Old Man Attributes Longevity To Typographical Error" from ''[[Wikipedia:The_Onion|The Onion]]''.<ref name="Hidalgo tweet">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1724844794856546805|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=That HNN story was my nod to this:}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Delemede system, and therefore Delemede itself, in grid square N-20.<ref name="TEA" /> Delemede was subsequently mentioned in a Diplomacy Crew Skill mission of the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="On Both Their Houses" />
